vraivelo.title: Our Story
vraivelo.subtitle: Born from a passion for cycling and craftsmanship, Vraivēlo is more than just a bike shop.

how_it_started.title: How It Started
how_it_started.text: Vraivēlo began in a small garage with a simple idea: that every bicycle tells a story. What started as a weekend hobby of restoring vintage frames quickly evolved into a full-scale dedication to the art of cycling. We realized that there was a gap between modern mass-produced bikes and the soulful machines of the past. Our journey is about bridging that gap, bringing artisanal care to modern performance.

who_we_are.title: Who We Are
who_we_are.text: We are a team of cyclists, mechanics, and designers united by our love for two wheels.

what_we_do.title: What We Do
what_we_do.text: At Vraivēlo, we specialize in breathing new life into classic frames and building custom bicycles that turn heads. From full vintage restorations to modern custom builds, we handle every detail with precision. We also offer expert maintenance services, ensuring your ride is always smooth and safe. We believe in sustainable cycling, reusing quality components where possible, and promoting a cycling culture that values quality over quantity.

story.heading: The digital heart of Vraivēlo
story.p1: The Vraivēlo Strava club is the starting point of every ride before the wheels hit the road. It's our shared space, where we organize, share and shape everything that happens outside the shop.
story.p2: Every weekend we propose a club ride open to the community. On Strava we publish all the information each cyclist needs: distance, elevation gain, terrain type and difficulty level. We believe a great experience starts with great planning, so we take care of every detail from the first moment.
story.p3: The rides are designed for group riding, sharing the road and enjoying the scenery. Some will be more relaxed, others more demanding, but all share the same spirit: ride together, no unnecessary rush, and with respect for the group's pace.
story.p4: The Strava club is also a meeting point. A place where connections are made, new routes are discovered and motivation stays alive all year long. It doesn't matter if you come every week or join from time to time: being part of the club means being part of the Vraivēlo community.
story.p5: If you like cycling, well-planned routes and a great atmosphere, you're invited. Just join our Strava club and start riding with us.

hero.title: ORIGINS
hero.desc: From competitive racing to precision mechanics. The story behind the workshop.

intro.title: <vraiWhite>Vraivēlo</vraiWhite> was born from a lifetime spent on the bicycle.
intro.text: David, founder of the workshop, grew up in Badalona and started pedaling barely three years later. What began as a childhood passion turned into a competitive career in mountain biking and later road cycling, moving through sub23 and elite categories to become part of a professional team.

competitive.label: The Competitive Era
competitive.heading: Pushing Limits on the Track
competitive.text: Competitive cycling demands more than just physical endurance; it requires a deep understanding of the machine. Years of pushing bikes to their limits in grueling conditions taught David the crucial relationship between rider and equipment.
competitive.quote: "Every adjustment, every repair, and every recommendation comes from real experience in training, races, and long hours on the bike."
competitive.author: — David, Founder

quote_banner.title: "Having lived cycling from within marked the difference."

building.label: A New Chapter
building.heading: Bridging the Gap
building.text_1: After closing that sporting chapter, the bicycle remained the center of everything, this time from the technical side. Years of experience in workshops and specialized stores allowed for the detection of something clear: there was a lack of real attention to the cyclist and their bicycle.
building.text_2: In December 2023, in Girona, <vrai>Vraivēlo</vrai> was born as a response to that need. A workshop created to care for bicycles with the same respect and demand with which one trains to compete.

bridging.label: A New Challenge
bridging.heading: Vraivēlo Grows
bridging.text_1: Only a year after opening our doors, <vrai>Vraivēlo</vrai> experienced unstoppable growth. The recognition of our hard work and the high demand meant that our original shop was becoming too small for the growing community that placed its trust in us. We knew we had to find a space that truly lived up to that trust.
bridging.text_2: This led us to our new location at <bold>Carrer Pau Vila i Dinarès 10</bold>. This move marked the beginning of an exciting new chapter: while continuing to provide a high-quality workshop, we evolved to offer our clients the very best in bicycles, components, and cycling apparel.
bridging.text_3: This project fuels our passion to keep working and delivering the excellence that defines <vrai>Vraivēlo</vrai>. With this new stage come new sporting and professional challenges, all driven by the same goal: to offer our customers nothing but the best.

hero.title: Vraivēlo x Berria
hero.desc: A retrospective look at our exclusive collaboration in the heart of Catalonia, where professional workshop expertise met high-performance bike engineering.

article.heading: Berria Demo Tour in Vraivēlo
article.p1: There are days that perfectly sum up what we are, and the Berria Demo Tour at Vraivēlo was one of them.
article.p2: When Berria asked us to be part of their Demo Tour, we were clear from the start: we wanted it to be an open, close event, true to our way of understanding cycling. Not just coming to test bikes, but creating a full experience around them.
article.p3: That day, Vraivēlo became the starting and returning point. The place where bikes were tuned, doubts settled, coffees shared, and that mix of nerves and curiosity before riding filled the air. Right from the early hours, the workshop filled up with cyclists eager to test, learn, and enjoy—many of them regulars, and others discovering us for the first time. The routes were designed to bring out the best in each bike. Small groups, staggered starts, and varied laps around Girona, blending quiet roads with stretches where you can truly understand how a bike responds when you push it. No rush, no pressure—just kilometers to feel real sensations.
article.p4: Throughout the day, along with the Berria team, we made sure everything flowed perfectly: adjustments, sizing changes, suggestions, and constant support. Because for us, a demo isn't just about hopping onto a new bike; it's about understanding if it fits you, your riding style, and what you’re looking for when you head out to train or have fun.
article.p5: The Demo Tour with Berria fit naturally because we share the same vision: cycling is lived on the road but built in community. At the end of the day, when the bikes went back on their racks and the shop reclaimed its calm, the feeling lingered of having experienced something special. A simple day, done well, and highly aligned with what Vraivēlo is: a space where the bike takes the stage, but the people matter even more.
article.p6: Stay tuned because we will soon have a new edition of the Berria Demo Tour.

weekend.headline: Vraivēlo Weekend
weekend.p1: Last year we organized a different kind of ride from Vraivēlo. It wasn't just another route, but a little two-day adventure designed to enjoy cycling with calm, safety, and a great atmosphere.
weekend.p2: The ride was structured and guided by David for a small group of 8 cyclists. We limited spots to control the pace, minimize risks, and ensure everyone had the best possible experience. The route was planned from the start: schedules, stages, and stops, ending in France.
weekend.p3: We left together from the shop and, from the very first kilometer, something special hung in the air. Backroads, shifting landscapes, and the feeling of sharing more than just distance. It was a demanding route both physically and mentally, but we always rode tightly and looked out for each other. All weekend long we had an assistance car providing constant support: food, drinks, logistics, and spare clothes when the weather turned against us—because yes, the rain wanted a piece of the adventure too. Thanks to that, all we had to do was pedal and enjoy.
weekend.p4: At night we stayed at a hotel where we recovered our strength and shared stories from the day. The next morning we started the ride back, tired but satisfied to have lived out something so unique. It wasn't an easy ride, nor was it meant to be. It was a real, well-organized experience shared among people with the same passion for cycling.
weekend.p5: After an experience like that, it was impossible not to think about doing it again. This year we are preparing <1>two Vraivēlo Weekends</1>, fresh adventures on the bike with the same attention to detail, same group spirit, and same eagerness to enjoy the journey.
weekend.p6: If you don't want to miss it, stay tuned to our social media at <1>@Vraivēlo</1> on Instagram and our <1>Strava</1> club, where we'll share all the updates.
